name: openpixo/crt-card-table
title: CRT retro pixel
description: Chunky pixel cards and menus seen through an old CRT screen, with soft glow and scanlines: the look of recent card roguelites.

description_i18n.en: Chunky pixel cards and menus seen through an old CRT screen, with soft glow and scanlines: the look of recent card roguelites.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 透过老式 CRT 屏幕看到的厚实像素卡牌和界面，带柔和辉光和扫描线，是近年卡牌肉鸽游戏常见的样子。

examples.title: Card back set
examples.prompt: Generate four matching card backs using the crt-card-table art style: comet, keyhole, twin moons and spiral shell motifs, each with a thick rounded border and bold flat shapes. Keep the CRT glow subtle and leave no lettering.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 crt-card-table 美术风格生成四张配套卡背：彗星、钥匙孔、双月和螺旋贝壳图案，均带厚圆角边框和大块平涂造型。CRT 辉光保持克制，不要任何文字。

examples.title: Modifier charms
examples.prompt: Create six matching modifier charm icons using the crt-card-table art style: lucky die, golden horseshoe, cracked mirror, fire opal, hourglass and clover. Use saturated jewel tones, soft phosphor glow and silhouettes readable at 48 pixels.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 crt-card-table 美术风格制作六个配套的增益护符图标：幸运骰子、金马蹄铁、裂纹镜子、火欧泊、沙漏和四叶草。使用饱和的宝石色、柔和荧光辉光，轮廓在 48 像素下清晰可辨。

style.prompt: Card-roguelite table art seen through a vintage CRT screen: chunky low-resolution cards with thick rounded borders and bold flat symbols, laid over a deep teal felt table with a soft swirling abstract backdrop. Saturated jewel-tone accents, soft phosphor glow on bright shapes, gentle barrel curvature, fine horizontal scanlines and a light vignette. Cards fan in a readable hand with a slight tilt and drop shadow; a playful high-stakes mood without real-world gambling brands.
style.negativePrompt: real casino or playing-card brands, photorealistic felt, dense glitch noise, heavy chromatic aberration, unreadable bloom, tiny card detail, muddy colors, baked-in text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: Thick rounded card borders and bold dark symbol contours; glow stays outside the shapes.
